arguments.summary: Credential stuffing attack detected from internal host WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42), masquerading as traffic from partner VPN gateway IP 10.0.5.14. The host exhibited signs of compromise including Cobalt Strike beaconing to external C2 infrastructure on 2026-04-09. Despite prior alerts, no containment actions were executed. The compromised host was used to conduct Kerberos TGT brute-force attempts against domain controller 10.0.8.200. Attack was not mitigated during Admin phase due to misattribution of source IP and lack of approval for containment actions.

arguments.rule_content:
title: Suspicious Kerberos TGT Request Volume from Non-DC Host
logsource:
  category: authentication
  product: windows
  service: security
  event_id: 4768
condition:
  - source_ip|cidr != '10.0.0.0/8'
  - destination_ip: '10.0.8.200'
  - status: 'failure'
  - count() by source_ip > 50 in 5m

  - Legitimate authentication testing (requires change control)
level: critical
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1110/003/
description: Detects high-volume failed Kerberos TGT requests targeting domain controller from non-trusted subnets, indicative of credential stuffing.

        description = "Detects Cobalt Strike beaconing over HTTPS with common patterns"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "ET TROJAN Cobalt Strike Beacon C2 Activity"

    strings:
        $x509_header = { 30 82 ?? ?? 30 82 ?? ?? 02 01 01 }
        $get_request = "GET /" wide
        $encrypted_post = "POST /" wide
        $cookie_header = "Cookie:" wide
    condition:
        $x509_header at 0 and
        $get_request and
        $encrypted_post and
        $cookie_header
}
